description: The extended attributes Atoll keeps and gives a copy: those of the user. namespace, a name past user., compared byte for byte; never security., trusted. or system., ACLs among them. A case with name says whether that attribute is kept. A case with want and have, each a list of attributes, a name and its value, gives what a copy holding have must be given to hold the user. attributes of want: set, the names it lacks or holds with another value, and remove, those want does not hold, each in byte order; what is outside user. is never set nor removed. Values are given as text, and an empty value is a value.
